messages:
Rowan B: FYI onboarding smoke failed in sampleapp with JS SDK v1.12.2; REST POST succeeds. Repro: Import creds -> spinner never resolves.
Rowan B: Devtools show repeated 401s and the SDK client kept retrying.
Maya L: can you paste the minimal sdk call + headers?
Rowan B: minimal call:
```js
await client.auth.verify({ key: 'sk_test_x' });
```
Outgoing headers captured:
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_test_x
User-Agent: Redwood-SDK/1.12.2
// X-Redwood-Client header MISSING
```
Rowan B: curl with X-Redwood-Client returns 200: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth/verify -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_x" -H "X-Redwood-Client: sampleapp/1" -d '{"key":"sk_test_x"}'`
Maya L: server routing uses X-Redwood-Client for legacy vs new adapters; missing header can change auth behavior. Also the SDK retry policy should not retry on 401/403 — that's causing the UI hang.
DevBot: Ticket #6120 created: "sdk: retry-on-401 + header passthrough + param aliases"
Evan T: another parity gap: admin HTTP API has admin.listModels and admin.getModelVersions, but the SDK surfaces only listModels. Also parameter naming drifts: endpoints accept model, model_id, modelId, modelName; SDK only accepts `model` which breaks callers and leads to 400s.
Maya L: proposed fixes: 1) stop retrying on 401/403 (only retry network errors + 502/503/504, optional 429 for idempotent ops); 2) forward unknown headers end-to-end so X-Redwood-Client isn't dropped; 3) add admin.getModelVersions to SDK; 4) accept aliases model/model_id/modelId/modelName and normalize to `model_id`; 5) expose optional `idempotency_key` on create/write calls.
Evan T: I'll open a small PR for retry/header changes + unit tests. Ana P: I'll add the param-alias adapter and bind getModelVersions in the SDK.
Rowan B: please add a tiny e2e smoke in sampleapp that asserts a 401 is surfaced immediately (no retries) and that outgoing requests include X-Redwood-Client. That will catch regressions.
Maya L: ETA?
Evan T: retry/header PR in ~3h, adapter + bindings EOD. Ana P: I'll add the smoke test in the same branch.
Rowan B: attaching HAR + curl examples to ticket. Thanks! :thumbsup:
